svg.title: مستشفى الحديثة العام | Alhadithah General Hospital
svg.desc: شعار مستشفى الحديثة العام برمز وألوان ملف تجمع الجوف الصحي المرفق، وخلفية شفافة ونصوص محولة إلى مسارات متجهية.
svg.metadata: Existing Alhadithah hospital lockup adapted to the supplied AlJouf Health Cluster SVG. All 33 emblem paths and their colors are retained exactly from that reference. The hospital name and cluster endorsement retain the supplied hospital lettering paths, uniformly scaled and repositioned without deformation. Reference canvas: 922.368 x 882.27594. No raster images, live text, external fonts, scripts, filters, or background shapes. This file records a requested technical adaptation, not an assertion of institutional approval.
